(SNPa) jaṅghāya hitaṃ vihāraṃ jaṅghāvihāraṃ, cirāsanādijanitaṃ parissamaṃ vinodetuṃ jaṅghāpasāraṇ'atthaṃ adīghacārikan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: atha kho māgaṇḍiyo chatt'upāhanāhi jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena so vanasaṇḍo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.

27797.grammar: prp of jaṅghāvihārati, comp vb, intrans

examples.text: atha kho hatthako āḷavako jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno addasa bhagavantaṃ gomagge siṃsapāvane paṇṇasanthare nisinnaṃ.
daṇḍapāṇi'pi kho sakko jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena mahāvanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami

27799.meaning2: bottom section of a monk's robe (the portion which hangs by the shins)
